name: Validate Card Number
description: Is this a payment card number? Checks the length and the Luhn checksum and names the brand (visa, mastercard, amex, other); answers { valid, brand, last4 } or { valid: false, reason }. Never store the number — keep last4.

data.assignments: [{"variable":"result","value":"{{= (() => { const s = String(number ?? '').replace(/[\\s-]/g, ''); if (!/^\\d{12,19}$/.test(s)) return { valid: false, reason: 'Not a card number' }; let sum = 0; for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) { let d = +s[s.length - 1 - i]; if (i % 2 === 1) { d *= 2; if (d > 9) d -= 9; } sum += d; } if (sum % 10 !== 0) return { valid: false, reason: 'Checksum failed' }; const brand = /^4/.test(s) ? 'visa' : /^(5[1-5]|2[2-7])/.test(s) ? 'mastercard' : /^3[47]/.test(s) ? 'amex' : 'other'; return { valid: true, brand, last4: s.slice(-4) }; })() }}"}]
